milestones.28000: Return disk-two request after disk-three load

milestones.37400-44000: Return to frigate and automatic landing

visualReview.inputSequence: Disk1->2->3->2. Backward input35000 starts takeoff; reversing later returns to ship. Idle remains on deck.
visualReview.firingLimit: Later fire presses occur after landing; weapon counter stays0x6000. Weapons/combat not qualified.
visualReview.audio: Sampled PCM presence only; not listened to or assessed for fidelity.

guestStateObservations.method: Read-only interpretation of captured guest RAM, supported by guest-code inspection and complete viewport review. Guest units are not physical measurements. No state was patched.
guestStateObservations.interpretation: Backward joystick input at35000 lifts the helicopter and moves it away. Reversing direction returns it to the frigate and automatic landing. Idle remains on deck. Weapon counter stays0x6000; firing coverage is not established.
